# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This file provides instructions for GitHub Copilot to understand the project context and coding standards.

## Project Context

This is a foundation repository with comprehensive documentation, workflows, and AI agent definitions.

## Coding Standards

- Follow the project's architecture decisions documented in ADRs
- Adhere to the contributing guidelines in CONTRIBUTING.md
- Write clear, maintainable, and well-documented code
- Include tests for new functionality
- Follow security best practices

## Documentation

- Keep documentation up-to-date
- Use markdown for all documentation files
- Follow the documentation structure established in /docs

## AI Agents

- Refer to agent definitions in /docs/ai/agents for role-specific guidance
- Follow the expertise and best practices defined for each agent role
